trajectory_notes: Revised 2026-09-21 after reading how the tool defines a verdict: reported yoy growth vs the guided range (or the stated direction when management gives only words), so it is about the growth RATE. Total: 50% reported vs 41% guided for Q3 = decelerating = down (revenue is still guided +13% sequentially). Gaming: -31% reported and a guided 'significant double-digit decline' = down. Data Center (107% vs '>100% in 2027'; management also says H2 accelerates vs H1), Embedded ('strong double-digit growth' vs 19%) and Client and Gaming (two segments in one guidance sentence) are left out on purpose: they are arguable, and the tool places only one segment per guidance sentence.
